mapper.select: SELECT p.id AS product_id,p.name AS product_name,p.thumbnail_url,p.price, p.stock_available,p.stock_reserved,p.stock_sold FROM products p WHERE p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY p.id
mapper.update: UPDATE products SET stock_available=stock_available+#{delta} WHERE id=#{productId} AND merchant_id=#{merchantId} AND stock_available+#{delta}>=0
mapper.select: SELECT m.id,m.order_id,m.product_id,m.movement_type,m.quantity,m.available_after, m.reserved_after,m.sold_after,m.detail,m.created_at FROM inventory_movements m JOIN products p ON p.id=m.product_id WHERE m.product_id=#{productId} AND p.merchant_id=#{merchantId} ORDER BY m.created_at DESC,m.id DESC LIMIT 100
